description: Use this when someone asks what their dental practice charges for a treatment, such as a cleaning, filling, crown or whitening. Returns catalog treatment names with price and last edit time, alphabetically, 50 per page by default. Not for a patient's treatment history or tooth chart.

clinicId.description: Only this practice (24 lowercase hexadecimal characters); every practice when absent

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page with the same filters; absent for the first page

limit.description: Treatments per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 50

name: list_procedures

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page

procedures.description: Treatment catalog entries in name order. Patient-linked treatments, tooth charts, diagnoses and record identifiers are never returned.

title: Look up treatment prices
